title: Blessing of the Naaru (Part 3)
summary:
Blessing of the Naaru (Part 3)



● Bounty Hunter: Synergies updated from Goblin/Assassin to Goblin/Draenei/Assassin.
● Faceless Void: Ability Reworked into Time Zone 
● Terrorblade - Metamorphosis: Now demonic Terrorblade will be no higher than the rank of Terrorblade.
● Draenei - Blessing of the Naaru: (2) Draeneis: steal a combined fixed and percentage health from the enemy instead of a fixed health.
● Demon Hunter - Shuttered Soul: (4) Demon Hunters: Allies don’t count as demons any more
● New Tier 3 Item - Minotaur Horn
● New Tier 4 Item - Havoc
● Bug fix

Click the title link to check the full update details!
